game_concept: A adventure race set in The Kingdom – Harvest Fields, farm fields beyond the walls: the royal scribe must handle mischievous imps while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Rename Rush: Pick valid variable names (no spaces, no leading digits) to unlock doors across the area.
theme: The Kingdom – Harvest Fields: farm fields beyond the walls
core_gameplay_loop: In Harvest Fields, repeat each round: Pick valid variable names (no spaces, no leading digits) to unlock doors across the area. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the royal scribe ahead. Then check the valid_names value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the drawbridge by solving code steps involving valid_names that move the royal scribe forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the drawbridge first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 3 (intro tier): Rename Rush
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rename Rush' (Week 1 slot 11), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Harvest Fields'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how valid_names changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mischievous imps in Harvest Fields.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
